text:
maria: Heads-up — saw a latency tail on prod during the 09:00 fleet ramp, looks correlated with small streaming requests (<= 256 bytes) to the gateway.
jon: saw it too, CPU on host-proxy spiked. flame: small write syscalls dominating.
kevin: can you paste the perf flame? curious if tokenize is in the hot path or grpc writev.
maria: pasted snapshot from the host that had the spike:

```
  35.6%  host-proxy  host-proxy  [.] ngx_writev
  22.1%  host-proxy  host-proxy  [.] token::tokenize_small_inputs
  10.3%  host-proxy  host-proxy  [.] grpc::streaming::flush_frame
  08.9%  host-proxy  host-proxy  [.] kvcache::lookup
```
kevin: interesting — tokenize_small_inputs shows up only for those tiny requests, probably due to extra copy for UTF8 normalization. jon: confirmed grpc frames are tiny (20-120 bytes) and we issue many writev calls.
dave: did we recently change batching heuristics? I remember a canary bump last week.
jon: we switched the gateway to stricter max_wait=3ms for latency SLOs, so smaller batches flush faster. That increases writev frequency.
maria: reproduction steps: run the replay harness with payloads sampled from 0-256B with concurrency 500 and max_wait=3ms. CPU spike reproducible.
kevin: quick wins: 1) coalesce small writes in host-proxy (buffer 1ms or up to N frames), 2) avoid extra tokenize path for ascii-only payloads, 3) tune kvcache lookup hot path to be lock-free for single-shard hits.
jon: +1 for ascii fast-path, that avoids the UTF8 normalization copy. but need unit tests for edge cases (surrogate pairs).
dave: what about changing batching heuristics to do size-aware flush? e.g., if batch token count < 64 then wait 2x max_wait. That keeps tiny requests batched.
maria: ran a quick local bench: with coalesce-buffer=1ms we dropped syscalls by 72% and p50 host CPU by 28%, p99 improved 15%. small increase in mean latency ~0.6ms.
infra-bot: deploy started: host-proxy coalesce small-writes PR (#4821) to canary group alpha-03.
kevin: also saw kvcache miss storm in the trace — 9% miss amplification due to fragmentation of prefix keys for short inputs. might need to normalize cache keys for tiny requests.
jon: action items: @kevin to open kv key-normalization PR, @maria to add ascii fast-path to tokenizer, @dave to propose batching tweak RFC. I can monitor canary tonight.
maria: putting reproduction harness and perf graphs in the thread: https://internal.tools/replays/6143210000
kevin: will add microbench for tokenize_fastpath + tests. aiming to land by EOD.
dave: RFC draft in #eng-runtime-docs, will ping y'all. :thumbsup:
jon: thanks team — let's validate on canary and if stable roll to beta tomorrow.
